root_cause.text: The function `ti_am335x_xbar_route_allocate` acquires a device reference via `of_find_device_by_node()` but never calls `put_device()` to release it, causing a reference leak on every call (including all error paths).
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `put_device(&pdev->dev)` in a new `out_put_pdev` label and modifies all early return paths to jump to that label, ensuring the reference is dropped. The CVE description and commit message explicitly state "fix device leak".
